scope.demand_definition: gs_orders despatch_date month sum(qty), 2023-01..2026-09; missing months zero-filled

candidates.name: 季节 naive（去年同月）
candidates.description: forecast[m] = y[origin-11 .. origin] same month last year; <12 months falls back to mean3

candidates.name: 近 3 月均值
candidates.description: constant mean of the last 3 months; recent level, no seasonality

candidates.name: 季节 naive × 近期同比修正
candidates.description: seasonal naive x shrunk, clipped trailing-6m YoY factor; skipped on short/near-zero/zero-in-window baselines

candidates.name: AutoETS / ETS
candidates.description: explicitly skipped: statsmodels and statsforecast are not installed; V0's hand-rolled additive HW is not reused as a candidate

candidates.name: 同类季节形状 × 本 SKU 近期水平
candidates.description: median peer monthly/trailing-12m shape applied to own trailing-12m level; peers are the other 9 SKUs with >=12 months

ets_status.reason: statsmodels and statsforecast are not installed in the project environment

backtest.rule: last 6 origins 2026-01..2026-06 with known h=1..3; fit uses y<=origin; targets origin+1..+3; no future data in fit
backtest.metrics: WAPE, bias (sum(f-a)/sum(a)), P90 coverage; zero-actual cells retained; all-zero denominator -> WAPE/bias null; target 0.90 recorded separately

p90.method: split-conformal empirical quantile of rolling-origin cumulative errors (A_h - F_h), finite-sample level ceil((n+1)*0.9)/n, method='higher'
p90.pooled_fallback: estimate_pooled_peer_relative: (A-F)/F from other SKUs' primary cells when own n<3
p90.delegated_excluded: origins where the candidate delegates to another model (e.g. seasonal_yoy skipped) are excluded from its calibration
p90.floor: P90 >= P50; negative residual quantiles do not lower the P50

seasonal_yoy.window: trailing 6 months vs same 6 months last year

peer_shape.peers: the other 9 SKUs, truncated at the same origin
peer_shape.own_level: trailing 12 months, or all history if <12 months
peer_shape.shape: median of y[m]/trailing12_mean by calendar month

aggregate.note: sums across SKUs are scenario totals, not a purchase/production order; P90 is per-SKU upper bound, not a portfolio P90

white_peak.interpretation: The Aug-2026 peak (280) is a repeat of Aug-2025 (240, the launch month), not a single wholesale order: it is 237 Amazon unit orders (qty 1-2), plus 32 Wayfair, 5 Shopify. But only two August observations exist, one is the launch month, and Jun-2026 also spikes (141), so the peak cannot be separated from launch/promo/listing effects. mean3 extrapolates the Aug spike to 107.7/month for Oct-Dec; last year's Oct-Dec was 2/5/15 (mean 7.3). Do not use mean3 as the Q4 baseline.
white_peak.recommendation: Keep Aug as an explicit event scenario, not a seasonal baseline. For Q4 use peer shape (47.2) / seasonal naive (22.0) as the low baseline and mean3 (323) only as an upper event-like scenario; need 2 more August observations or a promo/listing calendar to identify the peak.

low_ratio_skus.interpretation: ratio = seasonal contrast / YoY level: the denominator is the Jul-Aug-Sep peak, the numerator is last year's Oct-Dec trough. Jun-Sep 2026 is not >10% above the same months last year (often lower), so the 8-20% is mainly seasonal, not a forecast collapse or a recent-strength story. Sep-2026 is far below Aug-2026 and current available is far below positive open SO, so censoring is plausible; the trough may itself be understated.

open_items: Demand is shipped quantity (despatch_date), not unconstrained demand; stockout censoring is not corrected (only 3 days of stock_history).
gs_orders has no status field; cancellations/returns are not removed.
PO/ production / intransit overlap is not proven; supply is a bound (B_min=max overlap, B_max=no overlap).
PO ETA is empty for all 13 open lines; B assumes arrival inside the lead time, which is a scenario.
Work-order planned_end_date is empty; production timing is not confirmed.
Inventory uom_basis=unknown; all quantities are counted as pieces, no conversion.
Cover alternative stock is not merged into supply.
SO/WO snapshots are 10-20/21, inventory is 10-22; the 1-2 day difference is not bridged.
P90 is a calibrated estimate; achieved coverage is reported and may be below 0.90, especially with n<10 or pooled calibration.
The six low-ratio SKUs' last-year Oct-Dec trough may itself be censored; a stockout-corrected demand series is needed to confirm the true winter level.
